primaryEndpoint.observable: rhoS_h(f)=s_phys^T C_h(f) s_phys, with C_h=(Y_h+Y_h^dagger)/2 and s_phys the independently calibrated differential/traceless covector
schemeInvariantContent: the traceless projection cancels scalar stress improvement
absorptive spectral discontinuities are unchanged by real local polynomial contacts
a common invertible port-coordinate change leaves the scalar invariant when the covector is transformed contragrediently
primaryEndpoint.broadeningCaveat: a Lorentzian or Voigt line has tails at every frequency, so the operational onset is the lowest fitted pole or common-forward-model support edge, not the first mathematically nonzero sample

interactionAndEnvironmentModel.quasiStaticDisorder: Gaussian center jitter convolved with the homogeneous Lorentzian gives a Voigt profile
interactionAndEnvironmentModel.sectorMixing: rhoObserved_h=sum_k P_hk rhoTrue_k for a separately measured preparation-confusion matrix P
interactionAndEnvironmentModel.symmetricMixingAttenuation: for P_hh=1-epsilon and P_hk=epsilon/2, every zero-sum three-sector contrast is multiplied by 1-3epsilon/2
interactionAndEnvironmentModel.finiteVolumeRule: the lowest pole is assignable only when the gap to the next allowed pole exceeds one measured effective FWHM plus the frozen guard band
interactionAndEnvironmentModel.interactionRule: interactions may shift poles, broaden them, change residues, create bound states, or open continua; a numerical onset from the free toy is not transferable to a device without a matched interacting Hamiltonian

requiredStandards: cryogenic line or independently characterized load
requirements: full complex 2x2 S matrix at the device reference plane
error-box parameters and covariance in the same thermal cycle
pre/post drift standards bracketing every randomized sector block
one frozen map from laboratory ports to the physical differential covector
condition number and covariance propagated into every spectral contrast
reciprocity and passivity residuals reported without projecting failing data onto the physical cone
unavailableInCurrentProgramme: device-specific port capacitance and mutual-inductance matrix
complex transfer functions from room-temperature sources to both device operators
readout resonator dispersive response and amplifier noise covariance
proof that the two calibrated circuit operators realize orthogonal metric or strain sources

literatureAnchors.scope: demonstrates coherent AC interference in a six-junction switching-current experiment; it is not a calibrated A11 two-port spectrum
demonstrates gate-dependent AC spectroscopy and destructive single-fluxon interference; the sectors remain samples of a continuous charge phase
establishes that slow offset-charge fluctuations convert coherent phase-slip energy shifts into resolvable linewidth
current empirical scale for CQPS charge-noise broadening; device-to-device ranges are not an A11 signal prediction
a current hybrid Josephson/NbN AC spectroscopy platform with large tunability but visible quasiparticle-parity branches and short relaxation; it is not a protected Z3 platform

facts.calibration: in-situ cryogenic TRL with a pseudo-open correction

literatureAnchors.scope: shows that full cryogenic two-port error removal is practical; it does not calibrate an A11 stress analogue

resolutionFixture.warning: the 1 MHz shift, residues and SNR are injected planning values, not Spin23 or device predictions

invalid: passivity, reciprocity, KMS/detailed-balance, or calibration residual exceeds its frozen tolerance
port map condition number exceeds 20 or its uncertainty makes the contrast sign indeterminate
pre/post standard drift exceeds 0.03 MHz sector-differential equivalent
preparation-confusion matrix is singular or its contrast singular value is below 0.5
the common Voigt or interacting spectral model fails held-out residual diagnostics
the first and second allowed poles cannot be separated by the effective FWHM plus guard band
h=1 and h=2 fail the frozen CP-even compatibility test without a preregistered CP-odd term
window, pole count, line model, or differential covector changes after sector unblinding
operationalAdvance: positive familywise-corrected lower bound on the preregistered band contrast in two independent subbands
positive familywise-corrected lower bound on Delta_Omega that also exceeds one effective FWHM
the result repeats in two independent device or cooldown replications
dummy-gate, one-path-disabled, randomized-order, reverse-order, power-scaling and temperature controls pass
spin23AdvanceAdditional: a frozen microscopic action predicts the device-specific pole window, sector ordering, minimum contrast and port residues before labelled data
the physical two-port operator is matched to the conserved/traceless response rather than selected empirically
a separate protected-Z3 platform verifies sector algebra and protection; three AC gate settings do not meet this condition
poweredNull: achieved linewidth, calibration covariance, confusion matrix and sample count give at least 90 percent power for the model's frozen minimum pole and band contrasts
two independent replications place a simultaneous upper bound below at least one required model effect throughout the frozen window
preregisteredDecisions.inconclusive: valid data that meet neither operationalAdvance nor poweredNull

requiredExtraEvidence: W^3=I and three eigenvalues in one admitted low-energy space
validated nonlocal sector increment or string operator
suppressed local sector mixing with increasing separation or code size
poisoning lifetime longer than preparation plus acquisition
device-specific microscopic response and port matching

missingInputs: microscopic interacting AC-device Hamiltonian containing the proposed reader and its environment
predicted sector-dependent pole shift and spectral residue with uncertainty
device-specific matrix elements from both calibrated ports to the conserved/traceless operator
measured sector-resolved homogeneous linewidth and quasi-static charge-disorder distribution
sector preparation-confusion and poisoning transition matrices versus acquisition time
calibration covariance and drift at the device reference plane
temperature and drive-power dependence establishing the linear-response window
predictionGate.noGo: without those inputs, multiplying a literature linewidth by an assumed coupling cannot yield a defensible absolute power, integration time, or Spin23 exclusion
